notes: Multicam → Review & swap gets a big upgrade. Scrub frame-by-frame with ← →  and jump cut-to-cut with ↑ ↓. New "Split here" (X or Ctrl+K) cuts a shot at the playhead into two independent shots you can re-cut separately. New "Flag" (C) marks a shot to come back to by colouring that clip on the timeline — it stays glued to the footage (no marker to drift when you ripple-delete), and each flag is filed in a "PW Flags" bin. And a new "Flags" list shows every flagged clip — click one to jump straight to it; it re-reads the timeline each time so the positions follow your ripple edits. Set the clip colour + label in Settings → Flag for review. Fixed: pressing camera keys 1-2-3 quickly no longer crashes Premiere (swaps are queued safely), and the Studio spacebar now releases cleanly so Premiere's own spacebar stops playback. Save / Load state restores the planned cut reliably.
